verdict.rationale: Omnara's evidence describes it as an orchestration/remote-monitoring layer for launching, tracking, and approving agent sessions (YAML config, model connections, MCP tools, live following/correction) rather than an agent that itself performs autonomous bug diagnosis and code fixes; community comments frame it as a wrapper around external coding agents like Claude Code rather than an implementer of fixes. No evidence shows Omnara autonomously diagnosing or resolving a reported bug end-to-end.
